name: MODS Shortcut
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Hide the WAVEFORM heading and use MODS to open SOURCE for the official Mod Menu.
description: SDK-only community mod. MODS opens SOURCE; select MOD MENU to open the official menu. Idle callbacks skip clock reads. A stranded request times out with a SOURCE > MOD MENU fallback. Physical navigation and LOAD cancel the shortcut. Hide WAVEFORM heading blanks only its title area; touches pass through. Official core timing protections remain unchanged, and a timeout cannot re-enable a quarantined filter. Physical long-run timing remains unvalidated. No track loading, audio or library writes.
